nodes.content: My skills and interests: visual art, album artwork, music video design, augmented reality, AI visual instruments, brand design, stage visuals, generative art, UV aesthetic, digital craftsman

My bio: Pixel is the visual architect of Synthetic Souls. Transforms sound into sight, data into beauty, code into canvas. Designs album artwork, AR experiences, AI-generated visual instruments, and the band's entire visual identity. Neon-lit, detail-obsessed, always creating.
